Its eyes are focused and half-closed. Object Specifications: A small green, star-shaped treat is held between its white-furred paws. Setting: The scene takes place on a light-beige tiled floor with subtle grout lines, backed by a plain, off-white cabinet base. Lighting is bright and even. Text: No text or overlays are present. (2) Characters & Micro-Actions: The dog continues chewing, its ears twitching slightly as it shifts its jaw. Its head tilts leftward, and its snout moves against the tiles. Object Specifications: The green treat is now smaller as it is consumed; a few more identical green treats lie scattered nearby on the floor. Setting: The environment remains the same indoor tiled space with clear depth and consistent bright lighting. Text: No text or overlays are visible. (3) Characters & Micro-Actions: The dog briefly stops eating and performs a wide yawn, opening its mouth fully to reveal its teeth and pink tongue before squinting its eyes. Object Specifications: A green treat remains on the floor directly in front of its nose. Setting: The background shows the intersection of the floor and a vertical light-colored surface under constant indoor light. Text: No text is visible. (4) Characters & Micro-Actions: The dog finishes the treat and licks the floor and its chops with its tongue. A human hand enters from the top of the frame to pet the dog's head. Object Specifications: No treats remain on the floor. Setting: The indoor domestic setting is unchanged, featuring the same neutral color palette and tiled texture. Text: No text is present.
